guide.title: Feature guide
guide.subtitle: Learn what each module does, with highlights on AI song picking, team collaboration, and email-verified registration.
guide.featuredDesc: Tools built for worship teams — start here.
guide.allModulesDesc: Browse every feature. Use “Try it” to open the related page.
guide.agentHintDesc: After login, look for the chat button at the bottom-right on any main page. Describe the occasion, mood, or a lyric snippet — it searches the catalog, suggests popular songs, and leaders can add picks to playlists. Requires AI API keys on the server.
guide.teamsHintDesc: Create a team under Teams, then open Settings to search by name or email and invite members. On a song detail page, use Share to team; members see shared songs in the team’s Shared songs sidebar. Teams and chat are visible to members only — not the same as the free-text “team” field on a song.
guide.registerHintDesc: Tap Send code on the register page, enter the 6-digit email code, then submit. Unverified accounts cannot sign in. Without SMTP in dev, the code is printed in the server terminal running pnpm dev.

songAgent.title: AI song assistant
songAgent.desc: Floating chat to find songs, check trends, and add to playlists in natural language.
songAgent.tip1: Try: “Upbeat Easter worship songs for Sunday”
songAgent.tip2: Only recommends real catalog songs — never invents titles
songAgent.tip3: Chat history stays in this browser; you can clear it anytime

lyricsOcr.title: Sheet OCR for lyrics
lyricsOcr.desc: Extract lyric text from uploaded sheet images or PDFs in one click.
lyricsOcr.tip1: Fills the form only — confirms before overwriting existing lyrics
lyricsOcr.tip2: Needs Gemini API; unavailable when not configured

lrcKaraoke.title: LRC timed follow-along
lrcKaraoke.desc: Optional LRC lyrics highlight the current line while audio plays.
lrcKaraoke.tip2: Share pages show plain text; follow-along is on the detail page

tags.title: Type + style tags
tags.desc: Replaces single category with multi-select occasion types and moods.
tags.tip1: TYPE: Sunday worship, Christmas, children, etc.; STYLE: upbeat, solemn, inspiring
tags.tip2: Filter the library with AND across selected tags
tags.tip3: Click tag badges on song cards to toggle filters quickly

playlists.title: Standalone playlists
playlists.desc: Separate from meeting records — for rehearsal lists, themes, and sharing.
playlists.tip1: Create an empty playlist, then add songs from the library or detail page
playlists.tip2: Does not affect leaderboard stats (only meeting picks count)

ppt.title: Lyrics PPT generator
ppt.desc: Pick songs and download a projection-ready PowerPoint with lyric slides split by section.
ppt.tip1: Title slide plus up to 4 lines per slide; recognizes Chorus, Verse, 副歌, etc.
ppt.tip2: Merge multiple songs into one file and reorder on the Lyrics PPT page

share.title: One-click share
share.desc: Public links for songs, meetings, or playlists — no login required to view.
share.tip1: Playlist shares include full song info and sheet preview
share.tip2: Handy for band members or guest musicians

songs.title: Song library
songs.desc: Upload sheets, audio, covers; edit metadata and lyrics; search and download.
songs.tip1: Key, time signature, composer, album, MV link, and more
songs.tip2: Leaders and above can upload and edit

lyricsSearch.title: Dedicated lyrics search
lyricsSearch.desc: Besides title/artist search, search lyric body text separately.
lyricsSearch.tip1: Combines with tag filters and title search

scriptures.title: Scripture links
scriptures.desc: Attach multiple scripture references and optional verse text per song.
scriptures.tip1: Add on upload/edit; shown on detail and share pages
scriptures.tip2: Main search also matches scripture references

quickTags.title: Quick tag edit
quickTags.desc: Tap the cover on the song detail page to edit tags in a dialog.
quickTags.tip1: Requires edit permission; cover colors refresh after save

meetings.title: Meeting records
meetings.desc: Log songs, speaker, and worship leader per gathering; filter by year/month.
meetings.tip1: Search the catalog when creating; add a new song on the spot if missing
meetings.tip2: Meeting song picks feed the leaderboard

leaderboard.title: Song leaderboard
leaderboard.desc: Ranked by how often songs appear in meetings; year filter and pagination.
leaderboard.tip1: Choose all-time or a specific year

teams.title: Team collaboration
teams.desc: Private teams, search to invite members, share songs, and in-app chat — members only.
teams.tip1: Team list shows only teams you belong to; non-members cannot access
teams.tip2: In Settings, search by name or email; owners/admins can invite
teams.tip3: Share to team from song detail; view under Shared songs on the team page
teams.tip4: Not the same as the free-text “team” field on a song

emailVerification.title: Email verification signup
emailVerification.desc: Register with an email code before your account is activated.
emailVerification.tip1: Send code after filling the form; valid for 5 minutes
emailVerification.tip2: Configure SMTP on the server for production email delivery
emailVerification.tip3: In dev without SMTP, the code appears in the pnpm dev terminal

data.title: Import & export
data.desc: Bulk import from Excel or export backups by year.
data.tip1: Import requires leader role or above

i18n.title: English & Chinese UI
i18n.desc: Switch EN / 中文 in the header; preference is remembered.
i18n.tip1: UI strings only — song content stays as entered
